title: Skill Pilot Evaluation Query
description: Schema for a single gold evaluation query record in eval/queries.jsonl.

id.description: Unique identifier for the evaluation query.

query.description: User prompt or request text to route to skills.

domain.description: Primary task domain (for example: frontend, finance, data, devops).

split.description: Dataset partition; intent_family values must not leak between dev and holdout.

intent_family.description: Canonical intent group used to prevent train/dev and holdout leakage.

required_skills.description: Skills that must be retrieved for a correct match. Must be empty when expected_abstain is true.

acceptable_alternates.description: Secondary skills that are acceptable substitutes or complements.

forbidden_skills.description: Skills that must not be recommended for this query.

ambiguity_tags.description: Tags describing ambiguity or difficulty characteristics of the query.

expected_abstain.description: True when the router should abstain and return no skill recommendations.

expected_skill_count.description: Expected number of skills needed to satisfy the query.
